help_join.title: ❓ Welcome!
help_join.intro: You have reached the join page for this Battlefield game. Select a color, enter a team name, and click Join to get started.
help_join.step1: Pick an available color and give your team a name.
help_join.step2: After joining, you will be redirected to your team page.
help_join.step3: There you can place your ships on the board before the game starts.
help_join.step4: Once the GM starts the game, you can throw bombs at enemies and redeem codes at real-world locations.

help_team.title: ❓ How to Play
help_team.step1_desc: This is where your ships are placed. The enemy cannot see this board.
help_team.step2_desc: Click on an enemy board cell to throw a bomb at that coordinate. Hits are marked with a cross, misses with a dot.
help_team.step3_desc: Visit real-world locations to find codes. Enter them here to earn more bombs!
help_team.step4_desc: You need bombs to attack. Redeem codes to get more. The trickle system may also give you bombs over time.
help_team.step5_desc: Sink all enemy ships to be the last team standing!
help_team.bookmark: 🔗 Save or bookmark this page URL to return to your team later. You can also copy it with the 📋 button next to your team name.

help_gm.title: ❓ GM Guide
help_gm.step1_desc: Click on an available color card to add a team. Click a team name to rename it. Use the ✕ button to remove a team and free its color.
help_gm.step2_desc: Add AI players to fill empty colors. They auto-place ships and throw bombs during the game.
help_gm.step3_desc: Use the Start Game button once all teams have ships placed and locations exist. End Game stops the match.
help_gm.step4_desc: Pause the game to prevent all player actions (bombing, code redemption, trickle, AI moves). Resume when ready.
help_gm.step5_desc: Configure automatic bomb delivery in the Settings page. Teams receive bombs at set intervals.
help_gm.step6_desc: Visit the Locations page to manage real-world locations and their codes. Players visit these to earn bombs.

welcome.heading: 🗺️ Live Battlefield
welcome.tagline: A live, map-based team battle game.
welcome.step1: Receive a join link and share it to form teams.
welcome.step2: Place your fleet of 10 ships on the 10×10 board — ships can't touch.
welcome.step3: Visit real-world locations and redeem their codes to earn bombs.
welcome.step4: Each shot costs one bomb. Sink all enemy ships.
